caption: The drawing features a small wooden table set against a plain, beige background. The table has four turned legs and a rectangular top with slightly rounded edges. The wood is illustrated in shades of brown, with darker hues used for shading and adding dimensional detail. On the right side of the table, there are two visible drawers, each with a round knob. The overall composition is simple and centered, with the table occupying the middle of the page and ample empty space surrounding it. The artist's signature, "Edna Roz," is written in small print in the bottom right corner.
title: Sewing-table
